text_block_list.text:
Maruzensky checks her time and lets out a 
sigh.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if I've been overdoing it a bit 
lately?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
You might need a little maintenance so you 
can run even faster.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I should go for a drive on the 
expressway to refresh myself. It's been a 
while.

Fatigue seems to have built up in 
Maruzensky. Running in consecutive races 
might have taken its toll. I should 
probably review her race schedule...
